description: Expo apps. Patches within the SDK auto-merge, SDK upgrades wait on the Dependency Dashboard, and the packages the SDK pins never move on their own. Guard: expo install --check in CI. Extend after default.

packageRules.description: Look up patches apart from minors, so a package with a newer minor, such as expo-router 5.1, still gets its latest patch in the SDK, such as 5.0.7.
Expo and React Native patches share one PR and auto-merge. Guard: CI's expo install --check.
Expo and React Native minors and majors aren't offered as PRs. They move with an SDK upgrade, done with npx expo install --fix.
An Expo SDK major waits on the Dependency Dashboard for approval. Upgrade it by hand or with an agent, using npx expo install --fix.
Packages the SDK pins to an exact version only move with an SDK upgrade.
TypeScript majors only move with an SDK upgrade.
